scope: SCTBench CS.reorder_3_bad, CS.reorder_4_bad, CS.reorder_5_bad, CS.reorder_10_bad; Period and Serial; 3 attempts per setting
scope_reason: Thread-count series directly tests the paper's parallel-vs-serial schedule-space claim. The course minimum is three independent runs; the paper used ten. CS.reorder_10_bad needs about 125-145 seconds per search, so ten attempts per method would take over 40 minutes; three attempts are a declared reduced-scale reproduction.
ordering: attempt-major; method-major; subjects in listed order; sequential
replay: first saved failure of every found run; a replay dry-run abort is retried up to 3 attempts and every attempt is kept
dry_run_abort_policy: aborted_at_dry_run counts in the attempt denominator; it is not replayed and not replaced
replay_invalid_policy: a replay that runs to Perform Reproduction! but does not show the expected assertion is recorded as invalid_replay; its search row is kept for audit and excluded from aggregate metrics
not_found_policy: zero buggy schedules is a valid not_found outcome (paper '%'), not a tool error; total schedules and zero buggy schedules are recorded, first-bug is left missing
stopping_rule: stop for inspection on build failure, outer timeout, search abort after DBDS started, replay timeout, or changed originals
